paragraphs.text: On 12 March 2025, the riser pipe in my flat burst again and flooded the hallway ceiling and part of the kitchen. The manager patched it twice, once on 13 March and again on 21 March, and each time he told me it was the last repair needed.

I know there is a written repair deadline letter with the deposit warning somewhere, likely with the manager’s file from March 2025, but I do not have the paper in front of me. I am just saying it exists.

When I called on 24 March 2025, the manager told me on the phone that a medical confirmation of health effects for one occupant had already been discussed with the physician’s office. I am only repeating what he said; I have not seen any medical paper myself.

I want the damage in the riser pipe case checked now: did the building really have a lasting fix after the second patch, or are we still looking at an unresolved defect? What is still unclear to me is whether the repeated repairs addressed the root cause or only the symptoms.

paragraphs.text: Am 12. Februar 2025 ist bei uns im Steigrohr wieder Wasser aus der Decke gekommen, obwohl die Hausverwaltung den Schaden schon vorher zweimal flicken liess. Jedes Mal wurde es von der Verwaltung wie erledigt behandelt, aber am 14. Februar hat es an derselben Stelle wieder getropft und die Wand war erneut feucht.
Ich habe das Schreiben mit der Frist und dem Hinweis auf die Kaution zu Hause gefunden, und ich kann es Ihnen schicken. Es liegt bei mir in den Unterlagen seit Ende Februar 2025.
Der Heizungsbauer hat mir am 3. März 2025 am Telefon gesagt, dass er den Bericht mit Diagnose und Reparaturplan in den nächsten Tagen von sich aus schicken wird. Ich muss dafür nichts mehr anfordern.

Von der einen Unterlage habe ich nur noch im Kopf, dass darin etwas zu den Beschwerden eines Bewohners stand, aber ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich das richtige Schriftstuck meine. Vielleicht ist es die ärztliche Bescheinigung, vielleicht aber auch ein anderes Blatt aus dem Dossier.

Am Telefon sagte mir die Verwaltung am 18. März 2025, dass ihre Antwortchronologie zur Mangelmeldung schon festgehalten sei und dass sie auf ihre eigene Notiz vom 6. März verweisen. Ich gebe nur weiter, was man mir dort gesagt hat.

Ich möchte jetzt geklärt haben, ob die beiden Reparaturen am Steigrohr als behoben gelten oder ob die Sache weiterhin offen ist. Unklar ist mir vor allem, ob die letzte Flickstelle vom 11. März 2025 wirklich die Ursache beseitigt hat.

paragraphs.text: I’m dealing with a district-heating substation that has been supplying our flat below the contract temperature since 12 February 2025. On the morning of 18 February 2025, the living room was only 17.6°C even though the thermostat was set to 21°C, and the supplier is disputing that this is an actual defect.

The measurement service said it will send me the overnight temperature log for the occupied rooms automatically within the next few days, so I am waiting for that. I have not been asked to chase it again.

I have the letter in mind, but I am not sure whether that is the repair deadline letter with the deposit warning or some other document from the file. It is the one dated 20 February 2025, but I cannot tell yet which paper people are referring to.
No written response history from the landlord or property manager to my defect notice was ever produced. As far as I know, there has never been such a record at all.

The increase line matches the works that were done, and what I need checked is whether the figures and dates were prepared and dated correctly.
The landlord says they will send the signed notice or form on its own within a few days, so I am expecting it by the end of the week.

The letter may also mention the rate table, but I am not sure whether that is the same paper I am thinking of or a different one. I only know it was referred to in conversation, not which record it was exactly.
I have found the renovation cost breakdown at home, and I can send it if needed. It is the one showing the value-added increase figures, but I have not passed it on yet.

Please check whether the increase notice was built from the correct basis and whether the referenced rate table, the notice date, and the preparation time line up. What is still unclear to me is whether the full energy-efficiency cost was really passed through without any upkeep deduction.
